Container.Name: riff-roll
Container.Overview: Songwriting for rock bands: draw riffs in a piano roll and get colour-coded guitar tab, switch clean/distorted with pedal stomps, add drums and bass, and hear it through sampled instruments and an amp sim. Instruments are included in the image.

Config.Name: Projects
Config.Description: Your songs (.riff files). Back this up.

Config.Name: Instruments
Config.Description: Instruments you add yourself (the default ones are built into the image).

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User id that owns the appdata folders (Unraid: 99 = nobody)

Config.Name: Open sign-up
Config.Description: Set to open to let people create their own accounts. Leave empty so only admins add users.

Config.Name: Reset password
Config.Description: One-off: username:new-password resets a forgotten password at startup. Remove it after signing in.

Config.Name: Basic auth
Config.Description: Optional extra user:password in front of everything (accounts already need a sign-in)
